payload.note: Witten one-form checkpoint: for the exact finite-volume BT Gibbs law, the Helffer-Sjostrand operator L1=L0 tensor I+Hess S obeys L1*d=d*L0 and <v,L1v>=||d_mu_star v||^2+||dv||^2>=0. Hence the certified pointwise orthogonal-Hessian and low-action flat-Hessian witnesses do not obstruct the full covariance operator: field-space localization supplies the missing positive term. Splitting one-forms into the complete lowest axial sector P and complement Q replaces the invalid pointwise Schur complement by K_W=P L1 P-P L1 Q*(Q L1 Q)^(-1)*Q L1 P, with the usual finite-volume Friedrichs/cyclic-subspace interpretation. The next exact decision is volume-uniform coercivity of K_W on dT, or a normalized low-Rayleigh sequence with nonzero dT overlap. No coercivity, annealed score, H^-1, continuum, Born, Krein, or Lorentzian claim is promoted.
